verdict.summary: Fiserv cut 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $7.20-7.40 from $8.00-8.30 with organic revenue now -1% to 0%, lost its second short-tenure CEO in June (Mike Lyons to Truist), and Q3 showed adjusted operating margin down to 31.2% from 37.0% plus a $6.45B goodwill impairment; the peer group fell about as much, so part of the slide is sector-wide. Against that, Q3 beat estimates, guidance was held, Financial Solutions returned to 2% organic growth, Clover processing revenue grew 12%, savings target doubled to $1B and buybacks resumed, and the stock has since rebounded about 25-30% from the trigger price. Whether the margin compression and impairment mark a permanently smaller business or a reset before recovery is not settled; watch Q4 return to revenue growth, merchant margins and 2027 guidance. Note: the model notes still quote the old $8.00-8.30 2026 guidance.
